## Ghostship — rules for every agent (managed block, regenerated by `/ghostship init`)

This project is built with **Ghostship**. These rules apply to every agent and every CLI working here. Project facts written outside this block are owned by the project owner and stay authoritative.

**Workflow**
- Ghostship owns the workflow. Do not use another framework's commands (GSD, Spec Kit, Superpowers plans…) in this project.
- The Ghostship CLI is `node .ghostship/core/runtime/gs.mjs <command>`. State lives in `.ghostship/`; never edit `.ghostship/state/` or `.ghostship/evidence/` by hand.
- `tasks/*.md` are written by the CLI. Read them; do not edit them.

**How work is done**
- Test-first: write the failing test, record RED, then the smallest code that makes it GREEN, then refactor.
- Stay inside your task's `allowedPaths`. Never edit `tests/acceptance/` or a test locked after RED.
- Never mark your own work done. An independent judge decides.
- Every source file starts with a one-line comment saying what the file is for.
- Docs are part of the change: update the docs your change affects in the same task.

**Where things live**
- `docs/01-requirements/` PRD · `docs/02-design/` blueprint, architecture, threat model, API, decisions · `docs/03-acceptance/` locked acceptance checks · `docs/04-plan/` roadmap · `docs/05-code/` code map and guides · `docs/10-releases/` releases · `docs/11-memory/` memory, decisions, lessons, failed approaches.
- `docs/archive/` is history from earlier tools. Never treat it as current.

**Never**
- Read, print or copy secrets (`.env*`, keys, `~/.ghostship/secrets`).
- Change `.claude/settings*.json`, `.claude/agents/ghostship-*` or `.ghostship/core/`.
